note: Declared capabilities the router may hand to an already-approved adapter. A declaration is a pointer to existing, verified code. It is not a second skill engine, not a copy of any skill, and not an execution grant. Undeclared tracks (GZH vendor, X, XHS) are deliberately absent: they are rights-blocked or unmerged, so resolving them returns UNKNOWN_SKILL rather than a permissive answer.

skills.name: media-use
skills.summary: Agent Media OS adapter used by the M5 media_use stage for local-only BGM/SFX/image sourcing.

license.note: HyperFrames code is Apache-2.0. Bundled SFX carry the Pixabay Content License. A licence declaration is not commercial clearance for any individual asset.

rights.scope: local execution of the approved adapter and its runtime baseline only; per-asset rights stay enforced by the adapter's rights_reviewed gate; no commercial publication clearance is granted

contract.input: project.yaml media_use.requests (id, kind, intent, license, attribution, rights_reviewed) plus sources/assets.json
contract.output: receipts/media-use-stage.json, storyboard audio fields (bgm/sfx) and asset manifest entries

provider.note: offline local-only; network, paid and cross-project reuse are closed before a child process is spawned

runtime.note: the router asserts presence only; the adapter re-verifies integrity against the approved baseline at execution

verification.scope: offline local-only, single host, integration acceptance
